notes.why_in_news: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the Odisha Legislative Assembly, marking a significant moment in her political career.
notes.fact_box: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the Odisha Legislative Assembly on November 27, 2025. She had previously served as an MLA and minister in the Odisha Assembly from 2000 to 2007.

prelims_pointers.text: Droupadi Murmu is the first President to address the Odisha Legislative Assembly.
Murmu reminded lawmakers to maintain dignity in the House, as people watch Assembly proceedings online.
She lauded the Subhadra scheme for women’s empowerment in Odisha.
Murmu began her legislative career in 2000 as an MLA in Odisha.
